name: queens_n7__v8_nh
prompt:
Place 7 queens on a 7×7 chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Queens attack along rows, columns, and diagonals.

Return a list of 7 integers where the i-th integer is the column position (0 to 6) of the queen in row i, or state "UNSATISFIABLE" if no solution exists.
